text: MitosisEngine calibration defect (independent of the retired decoder phase): split_threshold ships at 0.3 while the engine's median tension is ~0.005 and the measurement-derived bar is 0.0397 — 7.6x too high. Threshold-driven mitosis has never fired on any path in this repo; mitosis.demo()'s single MITOSIS line is a forced split_cell() call. Fix on its own terms. Also open: MitosisC.__init__ force-grows by cloning cells[0], which merge_cells then deletes.
